title: Draft a note telling our landlord the heater is broken again

turns.text: Draft a note telling our landlord the heater is broken again. Firm but friendly.
bubbles:
Here's a draft:

"Hi [Landlord's name],

Hope you're doing well. I want to flag that the heater has stopped working again, this is a repeat issue, and with the weather cooling off it's becoming a real problem.

Could you get someone out to fix it this week? If it helps, I'm flexible on timing as long as it's soon. Please confirm when a repair is scheduled.

Thanks,

Alex"

Want me to send it as an email? I don't have your landlord's address on file, drop it here and I'll stage it for your approval.
